power-kit-ortho-gptimage2.png.prompt: Orthographic model sheet for a game modeller, on a flat neutral mid-grey background, zero perspective, no lens distortion. TWO small trackside racing devices for a tropical island circuit, each shown in a 2 by 2 grid of views (front elevation, right side elevation, top-down plan, three-quarter) — left half of the image is DEVICE A, right half is DEVICE B, all views of one device at the same scale. DEVICE A, the SURGE booster 'sunburst': a squat iron cage on a stone mount holding a glowing amber-orange core with four capacitor cylinders around it, a small radial sunburst ornament on top, worn cyan-painted stripe on the mount. DEVICE B, the SHIELD 'tide bell': a bronze bell-shaped housing on a stone mount, four hinged petals folded around a pale cyan glowing core, a fine lattice ring at the base, moss in the mount joints. Both about 1.6 metres tall. Early-2000s PS2 painted game texture style, flat even lighting, no drop shadows, no ground plane, no text, no labels, no arrows, no dimension lines.
power-kit-ortho-gptimage2.png.review: KEEP — build directly from this. Both devices in four views at one scale: surge cage + four capacitors + amber core + sunburst finial on the cyan-striped stone mount; shield bronze bell + four petals + cyan core + lattice ring + moss. Photoreal-leaning as all gpt_image_2 sheets are; the atlases give the flat look.
